item.title: Which River Goes in the Get? | Even HaEzer, Gittin 128:4-7, 129:1

item.title: Did They Reconcile? A Get's Hidden Doubt | Even HaEzer, Gittin 144:3-7
item.description:
Dayan Kada finishes Siman 144: a husband who dies before his twelve months are up, a condition tied to sunrise, and an instruction to give the get after a year. The key case is shema piyes, the worry that the couple reconciled or that she waived a condition made for her benefit, which is why the husband must declare that they did not, and the Rabbi gives a simple way to avoid the problem with a Beit Din.
